title: No Time for a Side Hustle After Work? 🧠
description:
No time for a side hustle after work? Here are three realistic fixes: tiny daily time blocks, work that fits odd hours, and batching similar tasks. Want more? Watch our latest long video on starting a business with almost no money.

es.title: ¿Sin tiempo para un trabajo extra después del trabajo? 🧠
es.description:
¿Sin tiempo para un trabajo extra después del trabajo? Tres soluciones realistas: bloques de tiempo pequeños cada día, trabajos que encajan en horarios raros y agrupar tareas parecidas.

#dinero #trabajoextra #negocios #motivacion

kapanis.soru: Which fix would you try first?

satirlar.metin: No time for a side hustle after work?
Number three: start with just thirty minutes a day, because small blocks add up.
Number two: pick work that fits odd hours, like weekend freelancing or tutoring.
And number one: batch similar tasks into one session, so you waste less time switching.
Subscribe and like for the rest of the series, and comment your pick!
